data.desc: IBC is a registered multibank financial holding company headquartered in Laredo, Texas. IBC provides a diversified range of commercial and retail banking services through 165 facilities and 245 ATMs across north, south, central, and southeast Texas and the State of Oklahoma. IBC owns five separately chartered banks ranging in size from approximately $567 million to $10.2 billion in assets, with IBC's consolidated assets totaling approximately $17 billion.
